cr_data.provenance: Daniel Catton Rich, Chicago, Illinois, gift, 1943; Michael Rich, Chicago, Illinois, bequest, 1979; Sotheby Parke Bernet Inc., New York, NY, sale no. 4235, lot no. 177, 19 April 1979 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Gift to Mr. Rich." Abiquiú Notebooks notes backing inscription, but records inscription date "1927." Backing inscription dates 1928. Whitney Archive indicates, "Painted 1927." Dated 1927 on basis of inclusion in 1928 exhibition. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: backing inscription, Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, 1928 New York (Intimate Gallery–O'Keeffe) exhibition checklist.
titles.title: Red Poppy

description: A huge orangish-red poppy with a black center stretches across the landscape-oriented composition. Its green stem is just visible at the bottom of the canvas. The flower contrasts with a plain white background.
imageCaption: Image has not been color proofed to current standards, and its colors may differ from the original work. The Museum will replace it when new photography becomes available.
